site.name: iynk
site.description: A hands-on hardware lab in the browser: build, wire, code, break and fly boards, robots and drones.

notFound.title: This page is not on the bench
notFound.body: The address may be mistyped, or the page has moved. Pick a lab to carry on.

untranslated.title: Not translated yet
untranslated.body: The text on this page is not translated into your language yet, so it is shown in English.

figure.failed: The figure did not load. Reload the page to try again.
figure.controlsHint: Everything you can press in the figure, as buttons.

usage.label: Anonymous usage counts
usage.body: iynk counts what happens in the labs (a lesson passed, a step built, a fault tried) for the live counters and leaderboards. Each event carries a random id for this browser, never your name or your code.

keys.title: Keys and usage
keys.notice: Kept in this browser only. It is sent to your own iynk server for each call and is not stored there.

server.label: Server token
server.hint: Only needed if your iynk server asks for one.

errors.empty: Paste a full key (at least 8 characters).
errors.badChars: Keys use letters, digits and symbols only, with no spaces.
errors.notPersisted: Not saved after you close this tab (this browser blocks storage)
